verdict.rationale: Meltano is self-hostable (own servers, free forever, Docker container support), which inherently gives users control over where data resides, but there is no explicit documentation of region/residency selection features, data-locality controls, or compliance certifications. missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration options, data-locality guarantees, compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/SOC2 data location commitments), and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments meeting residency requirements.
